title: FIB-4: age-specific liver assessment thresholds
summary: At ages 35–64, FIB-4 ≥1.3 prompts VCTE or ELF assessment; at age ≥65 the threshold is ≥2.0. A value >2.67 prompts hepatology referral.
population: Adults at increased MASLD risk in the 2026 CKM pathway, outside acute illness.
strength: Threshold table · separate grade not extracted
evidenceNote: Thresholds are table entries, not an independently graded drug recommendation.
cautions: Not applicable below age 35; do not use during acute illness.
FIB-4 stratifies risk and does not establish a diagnosis.

title: ACC/AHA: overarching BP treatment goal
summary: The overarching adult treatment goal is <130/80 mmHg, with additional considerations for institutional care, limited predicted lifespan and pregnancy.
population: Adults being treated for hypertension; individualized exceptions require review.
strength: Goal summary · table grade review pending
evidenceNote: The society summary does not supply a separate COR/LOE for this combined overarching statement; no single grade inferred.
cautions: Assess tolerability, standardized measurements and individual clinical circumstances.
